description: We're Anmol and Shabeeh, a 2-person team from India building for NASA Space Apps 2026 (Delhi, Virtual). Challenge: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots — reconciling two fire sensors into one comparable record, with a calendar heatmap and anomaly view. Skills: Python, data analysis, FastAPI, LLMs/agents, data viz. Shipped AI projects before. Looking for someone strong in geospatial data or frontend viz to round out the weekend build.
